description:
Hi, I’m Alexei, and I’m taking part in the NASA Space Apps Challenge with my brother, Ivan Guchin. I enjoy building software and designing tools that make complex information easier to understand. Ivan is a production engineer who brings experience in process improvement and practical problem-solving.

We’re competing as a two-person team. We’re excited to combine our software and engineering skills to explore NASA’s open data and build a working prototype that addresses a real-world problem.
